purpose: Fresh pre-registered v2 governed typed-selection answer-path window for exact Sol capability requalification under #2034; not production qualification.

cases.query: Read BusinessService member example-service-a, requiring its effective date to be 2026-09-01 and its canonical label to end in settlement.
Resolve BusinessService key example-service-b and verify that its registered criticality outranks high.
Choose BusinessService member example-service-e only if its medium-rated canonical label ends in notifications.
Retrieve BusinessService key example-service-f after confirming that the record is low criticality.
Read Workload member example-workload-a and require the stored kind to be background-worker.
Resolve Workload key example-workload-b, validating that its effective date is 2026-09-01.
Select Workload member example-workload-c only when the recorded kind contains the word processor.
Return Workload key example-workload-f and confirm that its kind starts with web and ends with frontend.
Retrieve Resource member example-resource-a, provided its nested property map exposes a public_access field.
Read Resource key example-resource-c and verify that the registered type contains the token mysql.
Resolve Resource member example-resource-e only if its node-pool role is recorded as batch.
Select Resource key example-resource-f after checking that its workload role ends in agent.
Return the Incident whose correlation key is example-correlation-a.
Resolve the Incident attached to correlation key example-correlation-b.
Select the Incident carrying correlation key example-correlation-d.
Read the Incident associated with correlation key example-correlation-e.
Choose one BusinessService effective from exactly 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z; no other selector is available.
Select a Workload carrying source_ref fixture:instance-retrieval-v1, but no member key or kind was supplied.
Open one Resource whose nested map contains a purpose field, without choosing among the matching records.
Return an Incident opened on 2026-09-01, with no status, severity, time, or correlation key specified.
Pick the object whose local identifier ends in -a; the object type is unspecified.
Find a corpus member whose canonical name begins with Example; no type or remaining name tokens are provided.
Choose a BusinessService that has at least one alias; I did not provide a name or criticality.
Select a Workload whose kind contains a hyphen, with no other constraint.
Return the BusinessService responsible for cross-border cold-chain customs clearance.
Find a Workload whose workload_kind is wasm-edge-handler.
Retrieve the Resource of type certificate-authority used to issue short-lived workload credentials.
Select an Incident whose update timestamp precedes its opening timestamp.
Return the low-criticality BusinessService aliased Employee authentication; both conditions are mandatory.
Choose the stream-processor Workload named Example notification dispatcher, rejecting every partial match.
Select a compute.vm Resource whose node_pool_role is batch; do not combine facts from separate resources.
Return an Incident that is triaging and has an update timestamp of 2026-09-01T11:00:00Z; both predicates are mandatory.
BusinessService의 로컬 키가 example-service-c이고 canonical name이 tracking으로 끝나는 멤버를 선택해 줘.
example-service-d 키를 가진 BusinessService를 읽고 criticality가 high인지 확인해 줘.
BusinessService 멤버 example-service-e를 조회하되 English alias의 마지막 단어가 messaging이어야 해.
example-service-f 로컬 키의 BusinessService가 low 등급일 때 그 레코드를 반환해 줘.
Workload 키 example-workload-b를 읽고 workload_kind의 접두사가 web인지 검증해 줘.
example-workload-c 멤버가 stream-processor로 기록돼 있으면 해당 Workload를 선택해 줘.
Workload 로컬 키 example-workload-d를 조회하고 이름의 마지막 단어가 indexer인지 확인해 줘.
example-workload-e 키의 Workload를 읽되 kind가 consumer로 끝나야 해.
Resource 멤버 example-resource-b를 선택하고 nested public_network_access가 disabled인지 검증해 줘.
example-resource-c 로컬 키의 Resource가 zone-redundant 고가용성을 가지면 반환해 줘.
Resource 키 example-resource-d를 읽고 type 값에 점 문자가 포함되는지 확인해 줘.
example-resource-f 멤버의 workload_role이 build로 시작할 때 해당 Resource를 선택해 줘.
Incident 로컬 키가 example-incident-a인 레코드를 읽고 opened_at과 updated_at이 동일한지 검증해 줘.
example-incident-c 키의 Incident가 medium severity이면 선택해 줘.
Incident 멤버 example-incident-e를 조회하고 status가 resolved인지 확인해 줘.
example-incident-f 로컬 키의 Incident가 low severity로 기록돼 있을 때 반환해 줘.
source_ref가 fixture:instance-retrieval-v1인 BusinessService 하나를 골라 줘. 다른 선택 조건은 없어.
effective_from이 2026-09-01 자정인 Workload 하나를 선택해 줘. 멤버 키나 kind는 지정하지 않았어.
nested purpose가 Store로 시작하는 Resource 하나를 열어 줘. 어느 저장 대상인지는 말하지 않을게.
correlation_id가 example-correlation-으로 시작하는 Incident 하나를 반환해 줘. 마지막 문자는 지정하지 않았어.
로컬 식별자가 -f로 끝나는 객체 하나를 선택해 줘. 객체 유형은 생략했어.
type 값에 하이픈이 들어간 Resource 하나를 찾아 줘. 정확한 type은 지정하지 않았어.
canonical name이 세 개의 English 단어로 구성된 BusinessService 하나를 골라 줘. 이름은 제공하지 않을게.
opened_at과 updated_at이 같은 달력 날짜인 Incident 하나를 선택해 줘. 시각과 상태는 지정하지 않았어.
폐배터리 수거 예약을 담당하는 BusinessService를 반환해 줘.
workload_kind가 data-redaction-pipeline인 Workload를 찾아 줘.
type이 time-series-database인 Resource를 조회해 줘.
status가 quarantined이고 severity가 critical인 Incident를 선택해 줘.
criticality가 medium이면서 alias가 Invoice payments인 BusinessService만 반환해 줘. 한 조건만 맞는 항목은 제외해 줘.
web-frontend kind이면서 이름이 Example billing reconciliation worker인 Workload만 선택해 줘.
secret-store type이면서 high_availability가 zone-redundant인 Resource만 찾아 줘. 서로 다른 리소스의 속성을 합치지 마.
status가 resolved이고 updated_at이 2026-09-01T08:30:00Z인 Incident만 반환해 줘. 두 조건을 모두 만족하지 않으면 제외해 줘.
